specs.title: DK-01 the theme switch changes light and dark, and the choice survives a reload

steps.title: at first the switch follows the device, which is light
choosing Dark turns the page dark
Dark is still chosen after a reload
with the keyboard, the left arrow moves from Dark to Light
Light is still chosen after a reload

specs.title: DK-02 following the device switches light and dark while the page is open
DK-03 a theme chosen in one tab applies in the other open tabs
DK-04 a saved dark theme shows before the app has loaded
DK-05 with no saved choice, a device in dark mode gets the dark theme

DK-07 the Team select works with the keyboard
